verdict.rationale: Plaid IDV documents risk checks with granular email and phone risk assessments and an overall risk score. Its product page says it checks whether the number and address are new, disposable, registered with external accounts, or breached, and workflows can branch on high-risk sessions. The evidence only shows these signals in the Dashboard, and none of it covers device fingerprinting, carrier lookups, or address history as distinct check types. Missing for 10: documented device fingerprint/device risk signals, explicit carrier checks, address history, API-level access to risk check results, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can enrich verifications with phone, email, and device risk signals — carrier checks, address history, device fingerprint — as additional documented check types

citations.quote: Identity Verification will also display a set of granular risk assessments (email risk, phone risk, etc.) in the Dashboard for each session, along with an overall risk score
